description: Most API requests each Developer dashboard page may start in one minute after it settles, idle and with one session making a model step and a tool call every second. tests/server/test_dashboard_request_budget.py enforces these.
cheapRevalidation: A 304 or an If-None-Match/If-Modified-Since request counts toward the budget but never fails the re-requested-unchanged rule.

session.note: Trace view. Idle: a finished session is still followed, backing off from 5 s to a minute, so its page notices a resume. Running: about 60 are the follower's own reads, one a second while events arrive. The trace and the overview (which carries the session's state) refresh every 2 s, the children and the transcript every 10 s. Once the follower reports event types, the overview refreshes urgently only on lifecycle events.

sessionConversation.note: Conversation view. Each transcript refresh is a size probe plus the tail page, every 2 s while following; the overview every 2 s; the trace and children every 10 s.

evalRun.note: A live eval run. Not measured by tests/server/test_dashboard_request_budget.py, whose fixture has no eval run.
